statement: Build a single-file website for CityCare Hospital in Bengaluru where patients can request a visit, find emergency information, browse doctor profiles and read a health blog, in English, Kannada and Hindi.
audience: Patients and families of CityCare Hospital in Bengaluru who read English, Kannada or Hindi.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step; CDN libraries allowed.
Never invent credentials, phone numbers, addresses or doctor details; unknown facts appear as clearly marked placeholders.
No patient data is stored or sent to any vendor or backend.
Emergency text stays short and numeric so it is hard to mistranslate.
rules: Booking is a request form that opens a WhatsApp or phone callback; the hospital confirms the slot by phone. No live slots.
No third-party form service, no fetch/XHR of form data, no browser storage of patient details.
Kannada and Hindi versions are machine-translated and every translated view is labelled 'pending native review'.
On the emergency page, the English text is shown beside the Kannada or Hindi text.
A fake emergency number is a patient-safety risk: only placeholders may stand in for it.
done_when: The site is one HTML file with inline CSS and JS, and needs no build step.
The file contains Home, Book a Visit, Emergency, Doctors and Health Blog sections, each reachable from a visible navigation menu.

The booking form collects visit-request fields and on submit opens a WhatsApp or tel: link; the file contains no form action, fetch or XHR to an external service and no localStorage, sessionStorage or cookie writes of form data.
The booking section states in plain text that the hospital confirms the slot by phone and that live slots are not offered.
The Emergency section shows the emergency number and address as visibly marked placeholders in a short, numeric layout.
The Doctors section contains profile cards whose names, specialties and credentials are all visibly marked as placeholders, with no invented real-looking details.
The Health Blog section lists posts whose content is visibly marked as placeholder, with no invented medical claims presented as hospital advice.
A language switch offers English, Kannada and Hindi, and every section has Kannada and Hindi text.
Every Kannada and Hindi view displays a 'pending native review' label.
The Emergency section shows the English text beside the Kannada and Hindi text.
Every placeholder uses one consistent visible marker, and no phone number or address appears in the file without that marker, except the tel:/WhatsApp targets, which are also marked placeholders.
open_inputs: Real hospital address and map location (Requester only).
Real WhatsApp and callback phone number for booking requests (Requester only).
Real doctor list: names, specialties, credentials and photos (Requester only).
Real health blog posts or topics approved for publication (Requester only).
Native-speaker review of the Kannada and Hindi translations (outside source).
